method.pss: Sum of Chromium process-tree proportional resident sets, sampled from /proc/*/smaps_rollup.
method.peakWindow: File-input change through the first completed new Sharp frame and five further completed frames.
method.caveats: Sampled peaks can miss shorter transients. RSS sums count shared pages repeatedly. This is Chromium/llvmpipe, not a physical phone. The read-only worker probe is appended only in this measurement, not production.
